title: Evaluation of the template formula
statement: For every natural number $\ell$, every Boolean predicate $p$ on strings of length $\ell$, and every assignment $a:\mathbb{N}\to\{\mathrm{false},\mathrm{true}\}$, the CNF template formed by excluding each length-$\ell$ Boolean string on which $p$ is false evaluates under $a$ to $p$ applied to the restriction $i\mapsto a(i)$ for $i<\ell$.
hypotheses_covered: assignment of Boolean values to natural-number variables
